prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Controlling Your Desktop Pet", "Try calling, dragging, and hiding your pet right now so you know how to interact with it on your desktop.", "Start Playing", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.", "Test Summon Pet"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's Unique Personality", "While your companion generates, explore the key traits and habits it will bring to your desktop.", "Your pet loves exploring windows and will react when you idle!"]
2: ["View Controls Guide"]
3: ["Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets", "Log into your existing account to restore your saved pets, or create a new account to save this companion permanently.", "Using the same account ensures your desktop pet memory is preserved.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
4: ["Check Your Photo for Best Results", "Ensure your photo is bright and clear so our pet engine can render your custom companion accurately.", "Clear face lighting & single pet in frame"]
5: ["Choose Your Companion's Journey", "Select a playstyle: Active Explorer, Chill Desk Buddy, or Interactive Storyteller.", "Select Journey Path"]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready for Your Desktop!", "Your pet is initialized and ready to roam your screen. Click below to spawn your pet on top of active windows.", "Spawn Pet Now"]
7: ["Launching Desktop Companion", "Building 3D animations and preparing desktop screen overlay...", "Initializing Desktop Renderer"]
8: ["Already created a pet before? Sign in with your original account to restore it immediately."]
9: ["Photos are converted into stylized 3D desktop avatars. Clear front-facing photos yield the best results!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photo of user/face)
